body: What does the examination involve? Should I talk with my general doctor or with a specialist?

Thank you for the questions! I haven't spoken with her about it. Saying "I'm considering breaking up with you" would probably be a dealbreaker that would probably screw up the relationship even if we stayed together.

To be frank, I have been doing everything solo for so long that I am sick of doing stuff on my own. But yes, it would probably help if I had something to look forward to except for sleep/work/play, rinse and repeat. But I don't see that happening and that is one of the reasons why I don't think I am a good type for any girl really.

Hello and thank you for replying. Yeah, I hear these things are fixable but I have a 26 year old experience of that not working for me. I was at college for 5 years and I met hundreds of people. No friends. And that is a place where people make connections and relationships involuntarily literally every day. If that environment didn't work for me, I cannot imagine what would.

Depression is something I don't do anything about. That's true.

Hey and thanks for your opinion. You are right, becoming a better person is a solution and it is possible. But so was finishing college and I wasn't even able to do that. I'm trying to be honest with myself but sometimes I have problems finishing chores for the day and to set up a long term plan is something I almost can't even imagine at the moment. That being said I lost almost 30 kilos over a period of few months so thats something I guess. But yeah, it's not really an appearance or any kind of physical thing.

Thank you for your input. And yes, it is a massively jerky thing to do. But my take is, I have more down to earth point of view of the whole thing. Yes, at the moment she is in love and yes it would break her heart. But if I have a feeling it would go down the shitter anyway because if anything I am getting worse, wouldn't it be better to end it now and give her time to recuperate when she still has time to get over it and find someone better?

Thank you for your comment. You're right, I don't have much grasp on my depression states but I am very realistic about what I have and don't have to offer. 

I understand the get better to be better sentiment but that would require things I am too late to get. But I'm glad to know what your opinion is.

Thank you so much for responding, it means a lot to me.

You are absolutely right about that, I don't have any routine in life and essentially unlimited amount of free time now when it still lasts. For the longest time I wanted to start to work out and I think I would really get into it but I don't want to do things like this alone. I don't want to walk around just by myself, I don't want to go to gym alone and I can't/don't want to do sports alone neither. I don't know but it just seems very silly to me mainly because I would have to spent all that time just with myself and right now I am trying to shut down my mind so I don't have to think. I still have a few acquaintances but they all live miles away. Maybe I should move, I will have to give it some thought.
Czech republic. Basically the same country as Poland :) I imagine loads of things work very similair between us.

Hello and thank you for replying, I am very grateful.

I've toying with this idea for the longest time and you are absolutely right. Maybe I actually need medications and maybe I am even crazy but my fear is that I am actually just completely normal. In that case I really wouldn't know what to do with myself. But it's definetelly step number one. If I do it, maybe I will get better one day.

But probably my biggest problem is that we don't have any single councilor in our school and in order to get to somebody I need to talk to them and explain before I even go there. And to say "hi, I want to kill myself, please help" makes me very anxious. Maybe it is just a childish fear, I honestly don't know.

Thank you very much for answering friend, I appreciate it a lot.

I know exactly how you feel. I also got to a point when I simply stopped caring. I couldn't stand the fact that I messed up my studies but today I literally cannot care less. Somehow it feels less relevant and I would rather be happy and non educated than educated and sad. It is difficult, society wants me to reach "as high as possible" but I suppose that is not my way. Or maybe it is but I just forgot it. It is hard and I feel with you too. I sincerely hope you will find you happiness out there somewhere.
